$comment: Sonata's resource budgets: the single source of truth (docs/BUDGETS.md explains each one and keeps the last measurement; tools/check-budgets.js measures them on an isolated copy, tools/check_budgets.sh runs it). Raise a limit only with Marcy's OK, in the same commit as the reason in docs/BUDGETS.md.

hiddenCpu.what: CPU of main, utility and Sonata's own pages with the main window hidden (the tray), nothing else open; the GPU process and Apple's page are reported, not judged

shownCpu.what: CPU of main, utility and Sonata's own pages in each state; the GPU process (software GL on Xvfb) and Apple's page (Apple's code) are reported, not judged

frames.what: compositor frames of the state's page (a DevTools screencast of it): resting pages draw nothing, the visualizer draws every frame while the music plays

repaints.what: Paint events of the state's page's frame in a trace: the main thread repainting (compositor-only animation repaints nothing)

memory.what: every app process except the GPU process and DevTools' tracing service (it runs only because we measure), after the quick run (every window closed, main hidden, a GC in every page)

listeners.what: the largest rise of any main-process listener count (ipcMain, app, nativeTheme, screen, windows, webContents), live webContents, active timers, or the rail's and panel's JS listeners and nodes, over N open/close cycles of every window

growth.what: soak: least-squares slope of PSS (every process except the GPU process) over 30 minutes after a 5-minute warm-up, one sample a lap

listenerGrowth.what: soak: the rise of any listener or timer counter from the first to the last sample after the warm-up
